purpose: Require explicit user authority before extending Real-account or Simulation position continuity beyond the last confirmed transaction date.
zero_delta_confirmation_scope: security conversions or corporate actions that change quantity or cost basis

state_transitions.WAITING_FOR_NEXT_COMPLETED_CLOSE: No user response is required because the research baseline has not yet been superseded by a later completed close.
state_transitions.USER_POSITION_CONTINUITY_CONFIRMATION_RE: User must explicitly confirm zero delta or provide all transaction deltas through the latest completed close.
state_transitions.POSITION_CONTINUITY_CURRENT: The delta ledger continuity watermark covers the latest completed close and WP5-E may recalculate proposals.
